title: Fig Tidies the Compost Heap
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.

pages.text: Fig has a neat compost heap.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar standing proudly beside a tidy, rounded compost heap in the garden.

pages.text: A storm hits in the night.
pages.illustration: A strong wind and rain sweeping across the dark garden at night.

pages.text: The storm makes a mess on the heap.
pages.illustration: The compost heap scattered with wet leaves, twigs and bits of straw, all out of order.

pages.text: Fig spots the mess at sunup.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar looking at the scattered, untidy compost heap in the early morning light.

pages.text: Fig picks up the twigs bit by bit.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar carefully gathering up wet twigs one at a time.

pages.text: Fig stacks the twigs back on top.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar placing a neat stack of twigs back onto the compost heap.

pages.text: Fig finds a flat stone under the mess.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar spotting one last flat stone hidden under the scattered pile.

pages.text: Fig packs the stone in too.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar tucking the stone neatly into the side of the heap.

pages.text: The heap is round and tidy again.
pages.illustration: The compost heap now neat and rounded once more, no mess in sight.
Fig the caterpillar sitting back, satisfied, beside the restored tidy heap.
